description: Source code for a static file plugin module in the lighttpd web server, handling static file serving with configuration merging, request processing, and plugin initialization.

methods.name: mod_staticfile_init
methods.description: Initializes plugin data structure for static file handling.

methods.name: mod_staticfile_merge_config_cpv
methods.description: Merges individual configuration plugin value into plugin config.

methods.name: mod_staticfile_merge_config
methods.description: Merges multiple configuration plugin values into plugin config.

methods.name: mod_staticfile_patch_config
methods.description: Applies configuration to a request based on plugin defaults and conditions.

methods.name: mod_staticfile_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration values for the static file plugin.

methods.name: mod_staticfile_not_handled
methods.description: Handles cases where static file processing is skipped.

methods.name: mod_staticfile_process
methods.description: Processes a request to serve a static file if conditions are met.

methods.name: mod_staticfile_subrequest
methods.description: Handles subrequest for static file serving.

methods.name: mod_staticfile_plugin_init
methods.description: Initializes the static file plugin, setting function pointers and version.
